locator: I q.2 a.3 co., secunda via: nec tamen invenitur, nec est possibile, quod aliquid sit causa efficiens sui ipsius
interpretation: Aquinas asserts it both as observed ('nec invenitur') and as impossible; only the modal claim is used, and it is derived (result AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-SECUNDA-VIA) from the priority premise and the irreflexivity of priority, which is the reason the text gives ('quia sic esset prius seipso').
